# microsoft365_graph_beta_device_management_settings_catalog_inventory_policy (Resource)

Manages Intune Settings Catalog Inventory policies using the `/deviceManagement/inventoryPolicies` endpoint. This resource enables collection of application inventory data from managed Windows devices through the extensibility technology platform.

## Microsoft Documentation

- [deviceManagementConfigurationPolicy resource type](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/intune-deviceconfigv2-devicemanagementconfigurationpolicy?view=graph-rest-beta)

## Microsoft Graph API Permissions

The following client `application` permissions are needed in order to use this resource:

**Required:**
- `DeviceManagementConfiguration.Read.All`
- `DeviceManagementConfiguration.ReadWrite.All`

**Optional:**
- `None` `[N/A]`

## Version History

| Version | Status | Notes |
|---------|--------|-------|
| v0.54.0-alpha | Experimental | Initial release |

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "microsoft365_graph_beta_device_management_settings_catalog_inventory_policy" "windows_app_inventory" {
  name               = "Windows Application Inventory Policy"
  description        = "Collects application inventory data from managed Windows devices"
  platforms          = "windows10"
  technologies       = "extensibility"
  role_scope_tag_ids = ["0"]

  configuration_policy = {
    settings = [
      {
        setting_instance = {
          odata_type            = "#microsoft.graph.deviceManagementConfigurationGroupSettingCollectionInstance"
          setting_definition_id = "windows_applicationinventory_applicationproperties_applicationkey"
          group_setting_collection_value = [
            {
              children = [
                {
                  odata_type            = "#microsoft.graph.deviceManagementConfigurationChoiceSettingInstance"
                  setting_definition_id = "windows_applicationinventory_applicationproperties_applicationkey_appname"
                  choice_setting_value = {
                    children = []
                    value    = "windows_applicationinventory_applicationproperties_applicationkey_appname_24"
                  }
                },
                {
                  odata_type            = "#microsoft.graph.deviceManagementConfigurationChoiceSettingInstance"
                  setting_definition_id = "windows_applicationinventory_applicationproperties_applicationkey_appversion"
                  choice_setting_value = {
                    children = []
                    value    = "windows_applicationinventory_applicationproperties_applicationkey_appversion_24"
                  }
                },
                {
                  odata_type            = "#microsoft.graph.deviceManagementConfigurationChoiceSettingInstance"
                  setting_definition_id = "windows_applicationinventory_applicationproperties_applicationkey_architectures"
                  choice_setting_value = {
                    children = []
                    value    = "windows_applicationinventory_applicationproperties_applicationkey_architectures_24"
                  }
                },
                {
                  odata_type            = "#microsoft.graph.deviceManagementConfigurationChoiceSettingInstance"
                  setting_definition_id = "windows_applicationinventory_applicationproperties_applicationkey_publisher"
                  choice_setting_value = {
                    children = []
                    value    = "windows_applicationinventory_applicationproperties_applicationkey_publisher_24"
                  }
                },
                {
                  odata_type            = "#microsoft.graph.deviceManagementConfigurationChoiceSettingInstance"
                  setting_definition_id = "windows_applicationinventory_applicationproperties_applicationkey_installdatetime"
                  choice_setting_value = {
                    children = []
                    value    = "windows_applicationinventory_applicationproperties_applicationkey_installdatetime_24"
                  }
                },
                {
                  odata_type            = "#microsoft.graph.deviceManagementConfigurationChoiceSettingInstance"
                  setting_definition_id = "windows_applicationinventory_applicationproperties_applicationkey_installlocation"
                  choice_setting_value = {
                    children = []
                    value    = "windows_applicationinventory_applicationproperties_applicationkey_installlocation_24"
                  }
                }
              ]
            }
          ]
        }
        id = "0"
      }
    ]
  }

  assignments = [
    {
      type = "allDevicesAssignmentTarget"
    },
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Policy name.

### Optional

- `assignments` (Attributes Set) Assignments for the device configuration. Each assignment specifies the target group and schedule for script execution. Supports group filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--assignments))
- `configuration_policy` (Attributes) Settings Catalog inventory policy settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configuration_policy))
- `description` (String) Policy description. Maximum 1500 characters.
- `platforms` (String) Platform type for this inventory policy.
- `role_scope_tag_ids` (Set of String) Set of scope tag IDs for this entity instance.
- `technologies` (String) Technology for deployment. Valid values: `extensibility`.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_date_time` (String) Creation date and time of the inventory policy.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier for this inventory policy.
- `last_modified_date_time` (String) Last modification date and time of the inventory policy.
- `settings_count` (Number) Number of settings within the policy.

<a id="nestedatt--assignments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `assignments`

Required:

- `type` (String) Type of assignment target. Must be one of: 'allDevicesAssignmentTarget', 'allLicensedUsersAssignmentTarget', 'groupAssignmentTarget', 'exclusionGroupAssignmentTarget'.

Optional:

- `filter_id` (String) ID of the filter to apply to the assignment. Required when filter_type is 'include' or 'exclude'. Should be omitted when filter_type is 'none'.
- `filter_type` (String) Type of filter to apply. Must be one of: 'include', 'exclude', or 'none'.
- `group_id` (String) The Entra ID group ID to include or exclude in the assignment. Required when type is 'groupAssignmentTarget' or 'exclusionGroupAssignmentTarget'.

```shell
#!/bin/bash

# {resource_id}
```
